title: Staff of the Wild

infobox.Crafting Materials: Ashwood x15, Fiddlehead x6, Celestial feather x9, Jade x3

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Staff of the Wild is a magic weapon that summons Root.
Each summon cast green projectile that causes blunt and poison damage on impact, and a thorny vine grows immediately from the area of impact. This gives two sources of damage from one cast: the initial projectile damage, and the lingering blunt/poison damage of the vine's attacks.
Roots cannot move and automatically attack all enemies within range. Up to 10 roots can be spawned at once and they last up to 25 seconds.
